title: Jovial Spicy Korean Chicken Tagine
description: A low-fat, nutty, and bouncy Korean-inspired tagine dish featuring doenjang, with a monsoon of Saudi-Arabian flavors, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in the bottom of a tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the doenjang, gochujang, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Pour the doenjang mixture over the chicken and add the tagine spice blend.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or noodles.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
